camel_example: aliyun sls PUT /context-models/orders --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body '{"sources":{"cn-hangzhou-app-logs":["*"],"cn-hangzhou-order-logs":["accesslog","errorlog"]},"displayName":"订单分析模型","description":"End-to-end coverage from order creation to payment"}' --name 'orders'
description_en: Updates the display name, description, and referenced sources of a context model
description_zh: 更新上下文模型的显示名、描述与引用的源
kebab_example: aliyun sls update-context-model --name orders --description 'End-to-end coverage from order creation to payment' --display-name '订单分析模型' --sources '{"cn-hangzhou-app-logs":["*"],"cn-hangzhou-order-logs":["accesslog","errorlog"]}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateContextModel

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the context model to be updated. This value is obtained from the request path /context-models/{name} and must be the name of an existing model under the current account. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are supported. If the model does not exist, a 404 error is returned. The model identifier cannot be modified
parameters.help_zh: 待更新的上下文模型标识，取自请求路径 /context-models/{name}，须为当前账号下已创建的模型名；仅支持大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）与短横线（-）。模型不存在时返回 404。模型标识本身不可修改
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: End-to-end coverage from order creation to payment
parameters.help_en: The model description. If this field is not passed, the original value is retained
parameters.help_zh: 模型描述。不传该字段表示保持原值
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The display name. The maximum length is 256 characters, and Chinese characters are supported. If this field is not passed, the original value is retained. If an empty string is explicitly passed, the field is cleared
parameters.help_zh: 显示名，长度上限 256 个字符（按字符数计），可含中文。不传该字段表示保持原值；显式传空串则清空为未设置
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The referenced sources. The project name is used as the key, so the same project does not appear repeatedly. The value is an array of selected Logstore names under the project. The structure is exactly the same as that during creation: `["*"]` indicates all Logstores under the project. Otherwise, it is a list of exact Logstore names. An empty array `[]`, a mix of `["*"]` and specific names, or names containing `*` are all rejected with a 400 error. If this field is not passed, the original value is retained because this operation is a partial update and only modifies the passed fields. Unlike creation, passing an empty object `{}` is rejected with a 400 error. To unbind all sources, delete the model and recreate it. Effective time: After a project or Logstore is added, the content is usually updated within a few seconds. After a project or Logstore is removed, the previously synchronized elements are retained for a period of time and cleaned up by automatic periodic synchronization. During this period, they can still be queried
parameters.help_zh: 引用的源：以 Project 名为 key（故同一 Project 不会重复出现），值为该 Project 下框选的 Logstore 名数组。结构与创建时完全一致：`["*"]` 表示该 Project 下全部 Logstore；否则为精确的 Logstore 名列表；空数组 `[]`、`["*"]` 与具体名混写、名字中含 `*` 一律被拒绝（400）。不传该字段表示保持原值（本接口为部分更新，只改传入的字段）。与创建不同：传入空对象 `{}` 会被拒绝（400） —— 若需解绑全部源，请删除该模型后重建。生效时机：新增 Project/Logstore 后，内容通常数秒内更新；移除 后，此前同步进来的元素会保留一段时间，由自动定期同步清理，期间仍可查询到
parameters.name: sources

schema.description_en: The response body. Returns the updated context model information
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回更新后的上下文模型信息

description.description_en: The updated model description. The maximum length is 1,024 characters. If the description field is not passed in the request, the original value is returned. If the field is cleared, an empty string `""` is returned
description.description_zh: 更新后的模型描述，最长 1024 个字符；本次未传 description 时回显保持不变的原值，清空后返回空串 ""
description.example: End-to-end coverage from order creation to payment

displayName.description_en: The updated display name. If the `displayName` field is not passed in the request, the original value is returned. If the field is not set, an empty string `""` is returned
displayName.description_zh: 更新后的显示名；本次未传 `displayName` 时回显的是保持不变的原值。未设置时返回空串 `""`
displayName.title_zh: 更新后的显示名；本次未传 `displayName` 时回显的是保持不变的原值。未设置时返回空串 `""`。

name.description_en: The identifier of the context model. This value is the same as the name in the request path. It is unique within the same Alibaba Cloud account and cannot be modified after creation
name.description_zh: 上下文模型的标识，与请求路径中的 name 一致；在同一主账号下唯一，创建后不可修改

additionalProperties.description_en: The list of selected Logstore names under the project. This is a string array. `["*"]` indicates all Logstores under the project and cannot be mixed with specific Logstore names
additionalProperties.description_zh: 该 Project 下已框选的 Logstore 名列表，为字符串数组。["*"] 表示该 Project 下的全部 Logstore，不可与具体 Logstore 名混写

items.description_en: The name of the selected Logstore under the project. A value of `*` indicates all Logstores under the project
items.description_zh: 该 Project 下已框选的 Logstore 名称；取值为 "*" 时表示该 Project 下的全部 Logstore

sources.description_en: The updated referenced sources of the model. The structure is the same as that in the request. If the `sources` field is not passed in the request, the original value is returned. If no sources are referenced, an empty object `{}` is returned
sources.description_zh: 更新后模型引用的源，结构同请求；本次未传 `sources` 时回显的是保持不变的原值。未引用任何源时返回空对象 `{}`
sources.title_zh: 更新后模型引用的源，结构同请求；本次未传 `sources` 时回显的是保持不变的原值。未引用任何源时返回空对象 `{}`。

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the model was last updated. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format, such as 2026-07-09T05:33:37Z. This value is updated after the display name, description, or sources are modified
updatedAt.description_zh: 模型最近一次更新时间，RFC3339 UTC 格式，形如 2026-07-09T05:33:37Z；修改显示名、描述或 sources 后更新

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. A JSON object that contains the fields to be updated. All fields are optional. If a field is not passed, the original value is retained. If an empty string is explicitly passed, the field is cleared
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。JSON 对象，本次要更新的字段。字段均为可选：不传表示保持原值，显式传空串表示清空该字段
